t: You're on Kingsway, a major road through central London, also known as the A4200. It runs from Aldwych up through Holborn, Bloomsbury, Euston and Somers Town, ending at Mornington Crescent. The name honours Edward the Seventh, who was King of the United Kingdom and Emperor of India from January 1901 until 1910. So when you read the street name, the king in question is Edward, and this broad thoroughfare is one of the ways his name is still carried through the capital.
